title: Verlinde 2016: Emergent Gravity and the Dark Universe
efc_relevance: de Sitter volume-law entropy contribution explains dark-matter phenomenology without particle DM. Predicts a MOND-like g_D(r) profile at galactic scales. Tested against RAR (arXiv:1702.04355) and against wide-binary low-acceleration anomaly (ScienceDirect 2024). EFC and Verlinde-2016 share a0 and dark-matter-as-emergent stance; discriminator is cluster-scale behaviour (Verlinde fails, EFC predicts Newtonian return).
ledger_action: Logged as EFC's closest living-competitor on dark-sector phenomenology. Required head-to-head on Bullet Cluster + SPARC + cluster-dynamics.
